name: What types of garage door materials are available for an upgrade?

mainEntity.name: What types of garage door materials are available for an upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common garage door materials include steel, wood, aluminum, and fiberglass. Steel doors are durable, low-maintenance, and come in various styles and colors, often with insulation options. Wood doors offer a classic, natural aesthetic but require more maintenance. Aluminum doors are lightweight and rust-resistant, suitable for modern designs. Fiberglass doors are resistant to dents and rust, offering good insulation and a wide range of finishes. Your choice depends on budget, desired aesthetic, and climate considerations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Materials include steel, wood, aluminum, and fiberglass, each offering different aesthetics, durability, and maintenance needs.
